name: Braid of Fire
role: Big-red mana engine / cumulative-upkeep age-counter payoff (#1 headliner)
text: Cumulative upkeep—Add {R}. (At the beginning of your upkeep, put an age counter on this permanent, then sacrifice it unless you pay its upkeep cost for each age counter on it.)
note: User #1 card: age counters add R each upkeep; proliferate grows the pool

name: Heart of Bogardan
role: Cumulative-upkeep age-counter time bomb (pay or it blows up)
text:
Cumulative upkeep {2} (At the beginning of your upkeep, put an age counter on this permanent, then sacrifice it unless you pay its upkeep cost for each age counter on it.)
When a player doesn't pay this enchantment's cumulative upkeep, this enchantment deals X damage to target player or planeswalker and each creature that player or that planeswalker's controller controls, where X is twice the number of age counters on this enchantment minus 2.
note: Pay R-mana each upkeep or it nukes; ties Braid of Fire mana to a clock

name: Magmatic Core
role: Cumulative-upkeep age-counter repeatable damage (Pyroclasm engine)
text:
Cumulative upkeep {1} (At the beginning of your upkeep, put an age counter on this permanent, then sacrifice it unless you pay its upkeep cost for each age counter on it.)
At the beginning of your end step, this enchantment deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures, where X is the number of age counters on it.
note: Growing board-wipe; age counters = damage; Braid of Fire pays the upkeep

name: Mystic Remora
role: Cumulative-upkeep age-counter card-draw tax (cross-ref blue)
text:
Cumulative upkeep {1} (At the beginning of your upkeep, put an age counter on this permanent, then sacrifice it unless you pay its upkeep cost for each age counter on it.)
Whenever an opponent casts a noncreature spell, you may draw a card unless that player pays {4}.
note: High elo but self-limiting via age counters; blue age-counter anchor

name: Glacial Chasm
role: Cumulative-upkeep age-counter pillow-fort land (buys time for slow wins)
text:
Cumulative upkeep—Pay 2 life. (At the beginning of your upkeep, put an age counter on this permanent, then sacrifice it unless you pay its upkeep cost for each age counter on it.)
When this land enters, sacrifice a land.
Creatures you control can't attack.
Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you.
note: Total damage immunity for escalating life cost; shields the count-to-win clocks

name: Mage-Ring Network
role: Storage-counter mana battery (Braid of Fire payoff / big-red sink)
text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}: Put a storage counter on this land.
{T}, Remove any number of storage counters from this land: Add {C} for each storage counter removed this way.

name: Squandered Resources
role: Burst-mana sink fuel (sac lands for big X / combo turns)

note: Cross-ref Tangle Wire/Parallax: dump lands for explosive X-spell turns

name: Carpet of Flowers
role: Anti-blue ramp (fuels big-X / High Tide hate)
text: At the beginning of each of your main phases, if you haven't added mana with this ability this turn, you may add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of Islands target opponent controls.
note: Cross-ref the High Tide/Islands archetype; green ramp vs blue prison

name: Astral Cornucopia
role: Charge-counter mana rock (big-red X sink + proliferate target)

text:
This artifact enters with X charge counters on it.
{T}: Choose a color. Add one mana of that color for each charge counter on this artifact.
note: Pay XXX to bank charge counters; proliferate grows the rock; slow ramp

name: Empowered Autogenerator
role: Charge-counter ramp battery (proliferate target, escalating mana)
text:
This artifact enters tapped.
{T}: Put a charge counter on this artifact. Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of charge counters on this artifact.
note: Self-growing mana; proliferate jumps it ahead; honest slow build-around

name: Trading Post
role: Grindy mana-sink value engine (user-named for big-red shell)
printings: BRC, C14, C16, CM2, LTC, M13, M14, MSC, PLST
text:
{1}, {T}, Discard a card: You gain 4 life.
{1}, {T}, Pay 1 life: Create a 0/1 white Goat creature token.
{1}, {T}, Sacrifice a creature: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
{1}, {T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Draw a card.
note: User-named: four modal sinks (goats/life/draw); honest grind, no fast value

name: Comet Storm
role: Multikicker big-red X mana sink (honest spent payoff)
printings: C15, C17, C20, CMA, CMD, CMR, MM2, P10, PRM, PWWK, WWK
text:
Multikicker {1} (You may pay an additional {1} any number of times as you cast this spell.)
Choose any target, then choose another target for each time this spell was kicked. Comet Storm deals X damage to each of them.
note: Cast-and-spent X-sink for Braid of Fire's surplus; scales but fragile

name: Spawning Pit
role: Charge-counter sac engine (proliferate target, token sink)
text:
Sacrifice a creature: Put a charge counter on this artifact.
{1}, Remove two charge counters from this artifact: Create a 2/2 colorless Spawn artifact creature token.
note: Banks sacs as charge counters; proliferate doubles tokens; grindy

name: Chance Encounter
role: Red counter alt-win (luck counters → 10 = win); coin-flip anchor
text:
Whenever you win a coin flip, put a luck counter on this enchantment.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if this enchantment has ten or more luck counters on it, you win the game.
errata_proposal: Lower threshold to 7 luck counters; also gain a luck counter the first time you LOSE a flip each turn (so it always ticks); ETB: flip a coin.
note: In-block (ODY) red wincon; needs coin-flips + proliferate; errata per #12

name: Darksteel Reactor
role: Colorless counter alt-win (charge → 20 = win); proliferate payoff
text:
Indestructible (Effects that say "destroy" don't destroy this artifact.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a charge counter on this artifact.
When this artifact has twenty or more charge counters on it, you win the game.
errata_proposal: ETB: put 3 charge counters on it (so it isn't a do-nothing for ~10 turns) and add a mana sink: {2}: put a charge counter on it. Headline proliferate payoff.
note: Cleanest count-to-20 win for proliferate; indestructible; errata per #12

name: Helix Pinnacle
role: Green counter alt-win (tower → 100 = win); big-mana sink
text:
Shroud (This enchantment can't be the target of spells or abilities.)
{X}: Put X tower counters on this enchantment.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are 100 or more tower counters on this enchantment, you win the game.
errata_proposal: Already a mana sink, so it pays its own way; ETB: put 10 tower counters on it so it isn't a pure blank. Proliferate-able shrouded win.
note: Glacial green wincon = pure mana sink; perfect Braid-of-Fire payoff; #12

name: Simic Ascendancy
role: UG counter alt-win (growth → 20 = win); +1/+1 payoff
printings: BLC, LCC, PRM, PRNA, RNA, SLD
text:
{1}{G}{U}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on a creature you control, put that many growth counters on this enchantment.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if this enchantment has twenty or more growth counters on it, you win the game.
note: Self-contained mana sink; turns block's +1/+1 / Amplify into a clock

name: Azor's Elocutors
role: WU counter alt-win (filibuster → 5 = win); interactive defensive
text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a filibuster counter on this creature. Then if this creature has five or more filibuster counters on it, you win the game.
Whenever a source deals damage to you, remove a filibuster counter from this creature.
note: Out-exception creature: only-in-block wincon for the WU/cleric pillow shell

name: Krark's Thumb
role: Coin-flip enabler (flip two, ignore one) — the flip linchpin
text: If you would flip a coin, instead flip two coins and ignore one.
errata_proposal: Add a mana sink so it's not dead without flippers: {2}, {T}: Flip a coin. (Now it always generates flips for Chance Encounter / Goblin Bomb itself.)
note: Turns 50/50 into 75/25; backbone of the Chance Encounter package; #12

name: Goblin Bomb
role: Coin-flip fuse near-win (5 fuse → 20 dmg); flip + counter payoff
text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may flip a coin. If you win the flip, put a fuse counter on this enchantment. If you lose the flip, remove a fuse counter from this enchantment.
Remove five fuse counters from this enchantment and sacrifice it: It deals 20 damage to target player or planeswalker.
errata_proposal: Optional: also gain a fuse counter when you win ANY coin flip (ties it to the wider flip package and proliferate); already does something alone.
note: Flip-fueled 20-damage kill; proliferate or Krark's Thumb accelerate fuses

name: Goblin Festival
role: Coin-flip repeatable ping (flip support for the luck package)
text: {2}: This enchantment deals 1 damage to any target. Flip a coin. If you lose the flip, choose one of your opponents. That player gains control of this enchantment.
note: Repeatable {2} flip-source feeds Chance Encounter; risk of losing it = decisions

name: Mana Clash
role: Coin-flip burn (repeat-flip damage); cheap flip generator
text: You and target opponent each flip a coin. Mana Clash deals 1 damage to each player whose coin comes up tails. Repeat this process until both players' coins come up heads on the same flip.
note: Many flips per cast = lots of Chance Encounter luck counters; swingy but low power

name: Fiery Gambit
role: Coin-flip escalating payoff (flip until lose; tiered rewards)
text: Flip a coin until you lose a flip or choose to stop flipping. If you lose a flip, Fiery Gambit has no effect. If you win one or more flips, Fiery Gambit deals 3 damage to target creature. If you win two or more flips, Fiery Gambit deals 6 damage to each opponent. If you win three or more flips, draw nine cards and untap all lands you control.
note: Pure flip lottery; huge upside with Krark's Thumb; decision-rich push-your-luck

name: Game of Chaos
role: Coin-flip doubling life swing (push-your-luck)
text: Flip a coin. If you win the flip, you gain 1 life and target opponent loses 1 life, and you decide whether to flip again. If you lose the flip, you lose 1 life and that opponent gains 1 life, and that player decides whether to flip again. Double the life stakes with each flip.
note: Escalating flip duel; many flips for Chance Encounter; classic chaos

name: Molten Birth
role: Coin-flip token maker (win flip = recast); cheap flip + bodies
text: Create two 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens, then flip a coin. If you win the flip, return Molten Birth to its owner's hand.
note: Always makes 2 bodies; flip-to-rebuy = repeatable flips with no card loss

name: Stitch in Time
role: Coin-flip extra turn (Izzet flip payoff)
text: Flip a coin. If you win the flip, take an extra turn after this one.
note: 50/50 extra turn (75% with Thumb); Izzet UR flip card; spent-on-cast

name: Impulsive Maneuvers
role: In-block coin-flip combat doubler (flip per attacker)
text: Whenever a creature attacks, flip a coin. If you win the flip, the next time that creature would deal combat damage this turn, it deals double that damage instead. If you lose the flip, the next time that creature would deal combat damage this turn, prevent that damage.
note: In-block (ODY) flip enchantment; many flips per combat for Chance Encounter

name: Risky Move
role: In-block chaos coin-flip (donate-and-flip control swing)
text:
At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player gains control of this enchantment.
When you gain control of this enchantment from another player, choose a creature you control and an opponent. Flip a coin. If you lose the flip, that opponent gains control of that creature.
note: In-block (ONS) every-upkeep flip; generates luck counters table-wide; chaotic

name: Mirror March
role: Coin-flip token-copy engine (flip per creature ETB)
text: Whenever a nontoken creature you control enters, flip a coin until you lose a flip. For each flip you won, create a token that's a copy of that creature. Those tokens gain haste. Exile them at the beginning of the next end step.
note: Flagged too_strong per #4: camps board, repeated free copies each ETB; user judges

name: Bomb Squad
role: In-block fuse-counter ticking removal (doubling fuses)
text:
{T}: Put a fuse counter on target creature.
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a fuse counter on each creature with a fuse counter on it.
Whenever a creature has four or more fuse counters on it, remove all fuse counters from it and destroy it. That creature deals 4 damage to its controller.
note: In-block (ODY) fuse engine; proliferate accelerates the bomb; high decision density

name: Crazed Firecat
role: In-block coin-flip body (flip until lose → +1/+1 counters)

name: Skittish Valesk

Proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)
Draw a card.

Draw two cards, then proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

name: Parallax Tide
role: Fading-counter land lock (cross-ref Tangle Wire / Parallax Inhibitor)

Fading 5 (This enchantment enters with five fade counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a fade counter from it. If you can't, sacrifice it.)
Remove a fade counter from this enchantment: Exile target land.
When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, each player returns to the battlefield all cards they own exiled with it.
